generation.scope: The mixed skew/symmetric marked chart is classified by a four-dimensional commutative Frobenius algebra with normalized functional and a projective nondegenerate ternary quadratic form. Regularity for all parameters, including nonreduced factors, is equivalent to nonisotropy of every lifted local socle in the matrix factor. Every finite point graph on this chart is regular, of opposite rank ten and minimal period two.

open_mathematics: Treat unequal marked matrix spans at opposite rank ten and above, finite graphs without a simple local component, positive-dimensional fibers and global components and specializations.
